text:
sam_gtm: Opening thread for MeridianCloud co-sell POC — partner asks: short private-tenant trial, security questionnaire, SSO, and an enterprise pricing ballpark.

toni_se: Meridian legal sent SSQ + a request for BYOK in prod. For pilot they're ok with redwood KMS if keys are ephemeral. Also want SIEM forwarding options.

emma_ps: I can handle SSQ answers and package a redacted SOC2 + controls matrix. Need to know if Meridian wants audit logs pushed to Splunk or just a CSV.

rahul_ops: We can spin a constrained private-tenant for 14 days if they sign a pilot addendum and prepay $2.5k for baseline capacity. Ops will supply egress IP ranges and teardown schedule.

kevin_arch: Performance ask: 50 rps at 300 tokens, median 0.16s/token. Likely fits a small reserved pool with KV caching. Ballpark reserved cost: $18k-$28k/mo depending on region.

toni_se: Meridian requires SSO before giving sample data. They use Okta (SAML) and want SCIM provisioning. Can infra share minimal SAML+SCIM samples?

infra-bot: SAML snippet:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.company/saml\">\n  <!-- ACS URL, EntityID, X509 cert -->\n</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM: POST /scim/v2/Users with bearer token header.

emma_ps: I'll attach SOC2 redacted + a short note on data deletion (default logs 48h, metrics 30d; extension possible paid). Ask Meridian whether they need HSM or KMS for pilot.

sam_gtm: Action items: 1) Emma = SSQ + artifacts, 2) Rahul = provision trial tenant + prepay instr, 3) Kevin = perf sim + sizing, 4) Toni = collect Okta metadata & SCIM prefs.

toni_se: I'll get Okta metadata today. Meridian agreed to try redwood KMS for the trial. SCIM = yes.

rahul_ops: Ops note: private-tenant trial will be rate-limited and single-az; not suitable for production traffic patterns. We'll include that in the addendum.

kevin_arch: I'll post a short runbook with load test steps and expected instance counts tomorrow.

sam_gtm: Great — scheduling a 30-min enablement next Wed for SSO + telemetry once metadata is in. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
